ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the initial admin account. Auto-generated during install.

LOGIN_ENABLED.description: Require users to sign in before using Stirling PDF. Recommended for private documents.

DEFAULT_LOCALE.description: Default interface language for first-time visitors. Users can still choose a different language in the app.

MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum size, in MB, for uploaded PDF and conversion files.

ENABLE_ANALYTICS.description: Allow Stirling PDF analytics after users consent in the app. Keep off for maximum privacy.

SHOW_UPDATE_NOTICES.description: Show in-app notifications when Stirling PDF detects that a newer version is available.

DISABLE_ADDITIONAL_FEATURES.description: Keep Stirling PDF's additional features enabled in the Docker image.

SECURITY_INITIALLOGIN_USERNAME.description: Username for the initial admin account.

SECURITY_INITIALLOGIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the initial admin account. Auto-generated during install.

SYSTEM_MAXFILESIZE.description: Maximum file size accepted by Stirling PDF, in MB.

SPRING_SERVLET_MULTIPART_MAX_FILE_SIZE.description: Spring upload limit for a single file.

SPRING_SERVLET_MULTIPART_MAX_REQUEST_SIZ.description: Spring upload limit for a complete request.

TZ.description: Timezone for logs and scheduled tasks (e.g. America/New_York).

app-health.description: Stirling PDF health endpoint is accessible
